model_graders.name: the candidate deserves to advance to the deterministic gates

rubric.anchor_1: generic, jargon-first opening with no reader problem or reason to continue
rubric.anchor_5: the reader instantly recognises the problem, sees the concrete payoff, and the body delivers it without hype
rubric.definition: line 1 makes the target reader stop and see the payoff
rubric.name: hook strength
rubric.worked_example: Fill this in with one real post that you scored 4 on hook strength, and say why it is not a 5.

rubric.anchor_1: the middle restates the opening or drifts into unrelated points
rubric.anchor_5: each beat adds a concrete new constraint, number, or consequence the reader could not predict
rubric.definition: the body raises stakes or specificity rather than restating the hook
rubric.name: middle escalation
rubric.worked_example: Fill this in with one real post that you scored 4 on middle escalation, and say why it is not a 5.

rubric.anchor_1: unsupported generalities or claims with no traceable source
rubric.anchor_5: every load-bearing claim is specific and maps to a body-read primary source
rubric.definition: claims are concrete and traceable to body-read evidence
rubric.name: specificity and source quality
rubric.worked_example: Fill this in with one real post that you scored 4 on specificity and source quality, and say why it is not a 5.

rubric.anchor_1: generic LinkedIn-model cadence with banned filler
rubric.anchor_5: indistinguishable from the owner's best published posts in rhythm and vocabulary
rubric.definition: the post sounds like the owner, not like a model
rubric.name: voice fidelity
rubric.worked_example: Fill this in with one real post that you scored 4 on voice fidelity, and say why it is not a 5.

rubric.anchor_1: a generic call to action unconnected to the argument
rubric.anchor_5: the closer follows necessarily from the body and asks for one specific, useful response
rubric.definition: the ending is earned by the body, not bolted on
rubric.name: earned closer
rubric.worked_example: Fill this in with one real post that you scored 4 on earned closer, and say why it is not a 5.
